concerns.analysis: Multiple meaningful images from the source PDF are missing in the HTML output due to missing image data. For example, the photograph of the swearing-in ceremony on page 5 is absent, replaced only by a comment indicating missing data. This also occurs for numerous other meaningful photographs, such as the signature of L.V. Pokey Harris on page 4, various PSAP visit photos on page 10, and the staff headshot on page 16.
